mkdir -p /opt/inventory-app
cat > /opt/inventory-app/app.py <<'PYEOF'
import json
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

INVENTORY = [
    {"sku": "A100", "name": "Widget", "qty": 42},
    {"sku": "B200", "name": "Gadget", "qty": 17},
    {"sku": "C300", "name": "Gizmo", "qty": 8},
]

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path in ("/", "/inventory"):
            body = json.dumps({"inventory": INVENTORY}).encode()
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8181), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()
PYEOF

After=network.target

User=root
WorkingDirectory=/opt/inventory-app

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
